items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: was the owner. He didn't care.

ctx.x: Well he came in and asked, you know what I mean. I wasn't paying no mind. We were playing.... I believe it was during the intermission. He asked me, is it ok to play. And I say 'yeah, what the hell, yeah, come up and play a couple of tunes.' I never even looked at his horn till he got on the stand and he said it was an alto, which I didn't like altos too much. Most guys play em squeak-- its too high pitched. But man, when he started out to play it was a different thing. He put a different atmosphere all around.…
was the owner. He didn't care. Didn't cost him nothin'. So, we played and played the next night and the next night and the next night -- every night I know he was there.
